title: Smithsonian digs up giant bones in American mountains

tellings.quote: giants were being unearthed by the Smithsonian Smithsonian institution in the mountains of America
In the Smithsonian Institution's own annual reports. You have you have evidence of of very unusual skeletal remains, many of which were very large
tellings.difference: Names the Smithsonian's annual reports as the source and calls the remains unusual and often very large, without saying they came from mountains.
tellings.link_reason: Both say the Smithsonian Institution recorded giant skeletal remains in America.

as_told.title: Giant skeletons recorded in Smithsonian annual reports

plain: The researcher Tim Alberino says that the Smithsonian Institution, the US national museum and research body, dug up the bones of giants in the mountains of America. In the same conversation he points to the Smithsonian's own annual reports, saying they record very unusual skeletal remains, many of them very large, though there he does not say they came from mountains. If true, it would mean a respected public institution once found and wrote down evidence of giant humans.
